provisions.cite: 31 CFR 351.34(a) (Series EE bonds issued May 1, 2005 or later: original maturity)
provisions.quote: Bonds reach original maturity at 20 years after the issue date
provisions.verified: 2026-10-04, quote matches law.cornell.edu (e-CFR text, 70 FR 17288-17289, Apr. 9, 2005)

provisions.cite: 31 CFR 351.35(f)(2) (redemption value of book-entry Series EE bonds at original maturity)
provisions.quote: At original maturity, the redemption value of a book-entry bond shall not be less than double the purchase price of the bond.
provisions.verified: 2026-10-04, quote matches law.cornell.edu (e-CFR text, 70 FR 17288-17289, Apr. 9, 2005)
provisions.note: (f)(1) for paper (definitive) bonds: value at original maturity not less than face amount; paper EE bonds were sold at half of face, so both forms double.
